column1: # Ticket 274: every production file that reads a shell/OS account name. Each row's file must also
# call ActorId.Mint — the derivation is minted where it is read, so every downstream
# `new ActorId(...)` stays a refusing boundary. A new row here is a new identity derivation.
# 2026-09-09 (294 s2a): AdministratorRecoveryCommand derives through the composition root's
# founder-principal function; it no longer reads or mints a shell-derived party key.
# 2026-09-09 (294 s2b): CurrentPrincipalSignatureRoutes now receives the canonical
# tenant principal from composition and no longer derives a shell identity.
